about: The edit went into his post through its editor, as on 1 and 2 November: the Find string once, in one run of text with no marks; one transaction (the editor's document 421a7902 before, fcd20edb after); the draft saved; Update, then "Update now" (Substack's publish call answered 200; the public post showed the change about three minutes later). The public post, read through Substack's API from the laptop without signing in (POST.json), has the change and the working copy's words.
